description: A Dart source file defining the ApiClient class, which provides an HTTP client wrapper with features such as base URL management, token handling, JSON encoding/decoding, and retry logic for network requests.

classes.name: ApiClient
classes.description: A class providing HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with built-in token management, base URL configuration, JSON handling, and retries.

methods.name: baseUrl
methods.description: Returns the base URL from environment variables; throws error if not set.

methods.name: saveToken
methods.description: Stores an authentication token in shared preferences.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token, if any.

methods.name: _defaultHeaders
methods.description: Builds default headers including Content-Type, Accept, and Authorization (if token exists).

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request with optional query parameters, headers, and retry logic.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body, headers, and retry logic.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON body, headers, and retry logic.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request with optional body, headers, and retry logic.

methods.name: _buildUri
methods.description: Constructs a full Uri from base URL, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: _encodeBody
methods.description: Encodes request body to JSON if necessary.

methods.name: _withRetry
methods.description: Wraps a network request with exponential backoff retry logic for transient errors.

methods.name: parseJsonBody
methods.description: Parses the response body as JSON, returning Map or List.

methods.name: isSuccessStatus
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP status code indicates success (2xx).
